units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 39:20">Targ. Job XXXIX, 20</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:4">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>לדמא דאתי מנ׳</he> for bleeding from the nose.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>נפיץ ושרי … מנְחִירֵיה</he> blew his nose and threw bands of silk out of his nose (Rashi: <he>מנְחִירָיו</he>, v. <cite ref="N00491">preced.</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְחִירִין</he>, <he>נְחִירֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 115:6">Targ. Ps. CXV, 6</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:3:2">Y. Yeb. XVI, beg. 15ᶜ</cite> <he>יהבין … על נְחִירֵיהוֹן</he> put plasters on their noses (to disguise themselves); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:3:2">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> bot.; v. <cite ref="O00798"><he>סִיפְלָנִי</he></cite>.
